title: TensorFold native engine gate manifest (zig/gate.json)
description: The cells where the native engine passed the release gate: the Python engine's token SHAs, drafted equal to serial, streams equal to solo, resumed equal to fresh, and at least its speed in every cell. A platform wheel carries it beside the bundle, and `tensorfold serve` with engine auto runs the native engine only on a listed cell with the listed bundle. Without entries, every command runs the Python engine.

format.description: Its weight format, as tensorfold.native.contract.weight_format names it: mlx-q4g64, mlx-q4g64-q8g64 (mixed layers), exl3-b4, unquantized.

chip.description: The chip class the native engine reported on the gate machine.

run.description: The release gate run that passed the cell: a public label, never a machine name.

bundle.description: sha256 of the native bundle that passed (tensorfold.native.bundle_digest).
